text.en:
The parcels of land herein granted shall be used exclusively for housing projects purposes and
shall not be encumbered, alienated of transferred except in favor of persons, corporations or associations
qualified to acquire public lands and with the approval of the President of the Philippines.

The Register of Deeds concerned shall register the above-described parcels of land and issue the
corresponding certificates of title to the Provincial Government of Tawi-Tawi.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
